documents.title: Anlon Healthcare Limited Has informed Regarding Corrigendum To Notice Of Annual General Meeting To Be Held On September 05, 2026
Notice Of 13Th Annual General Meeting Of Anlon Healthcare Limited

analysis.summary: Anlon Healthcare held its Q1 FY27 earnings conference call, reporting total consolidated income of 87.62 crore and EBITDA of 15.65 crore, while EBITDA margin moderated to approximately 17% due to raw material price hikes and the consolidation of Remember India Health links. Management maintained its full-year FY27 revenue guidance at 350 to 400 crore and expects EBITDA margins to recover to the 25% to 30% range by Q3 FY27. The company is actively pursuing strategic expansions, including a 130 crore capex at the Anlon site and increasing stakes in its subsidiaries to 100%. Furthermore, the company projected standalone Anlon revenue of around 180 crore and consolidated PAT margins of 12% to 13% for FY27. Anlon Healthcare released its Q1 and FY27 investor presentation highlighting its manufacturing capabilities, recent acquisitions, and operational metrics.

guidance.claim: Management projects PAT margins for FY27 to be somewhere around 12 to 13%.
guidance.quote: That is somewhere around I think 12 to 13%.

guidance.claim: Standalone Anlon revenue for FY27 is predicted to be around 180 crore.
guidance.quote: It would be similar one because we are already running on the peak level. So around 180.

guidance.claim: The company expects revenue between INR 380 to 400 crore for FY27.
guidance.quote: That should be right now the whatever the visibility we are having, it is between INR 380 to 400 CR for FY27.

guidance.claim: Management targets revenue between INR 700 to 800 crore for FY28.
guidance.quote: Yeah, FY28 we are expecting between 700 to 800 CR.

guidance.claim: The company aims to maintain EBITDA margins in the range of 25% to 30%.
guidance.quote: Supported by our expanded manufacturing platform, regulatory capabilities and diversified product portfolio and strategic acquisition, we remain confident of delivering approximately 30% of revenue CAGR over the next three years while working towards maintaining EBITDA margin in the range of 25 to 30%.

demand_outlook.claim: The industrial and fine chemical business in Apiqo Organics is fully booked and overbooked.
demand_outlook.quote: Yeah, that in Apiqo Organics that we are doing is industrial and fine chemical as well and that we are already fully booked and you can say like the overbooked. So, there is no any issues with the any business or anything.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is seeing encouraging early traction in the industrial and fine chemical segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Alongside our core pharmaceutical business, we have also diversified into the industrial and fine chemical segment, which is witnessing encouraging early traction and complements our existing capabilities, customer relationships and growth strategy.

capex_expansion.claim: Anlon is undertaking new capex of around 130 crore for expansion at the Anlon site.
capex_expansion.quote: Expansion, yes, we are already doing the expansion for the around 130 CR of the new CAPEX.

capex_expansion.claim: Standalone Anlon's capacity after the new expansion is expected to be around 1600 metric ton.
capex_expansion.quote: So that will be the standalone Anlon's capacity would be somewhere around 1600 metric ton.

capex_expansion.claim: The acquisition of Apiqo provides incremental capacity of 700 to 800 MTPA.
The Bizotic acquisition provides an additional 300 to 400 MTPA capacity.
The total projected capacity is expected to reach 1400 to 1600 MTPA by FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: Total projected capacity: 1,400–1,600 MTPA by FY26

capex_expansion.claim: The new facility is expected to be commissioned by Q1 of FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: Uh, mostly by Q1 of FY28.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices, specifically for petroleum-derived solvents like methanol, increased two to three times compared to pre-war times.
margins_costs.quote: Yeah, you can say like the methanol was 22 rupees, now it is almost 58 to 60 rupees.

margins_costs.claim: The interest rate on the 70 crore debt taken for the new capex will be around 8.5 to 8.6%.
margins_costs.quote: It will be somewhere around 8.5 to 8.6%.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects consolidated EBITDA margins to remain between 24% and 25%.
margins_costs.quote: but consolidated overall margin would be between 24-25 and we'll not go below that margin.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization across the combined setup is running around 65% to 70%.
orders_capacity.quote: I think that is somewhere around 65 to 70%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has a clear order book visibility of INR 280 to 300 crore for the current year.
orders_capacity.quote: See, right now we have the clear visibility in terms of the order book is somewhere around INR 280 to 300 CR for the whole year in consolidation basis.

orders_capacity.claim: The combined installed capacity is approximately 1400 to 1600 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: With this initiative, our combined installed capacity has expanded to approximately 1400 to 1600 metric ton per annum, positioning us for the next phase of scale growth.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has started the process to make Apiqo and Bizoc 100% wholly-owned subsidiaries by way of share swapping.
capital_allocation.quote: Yeah, but we have already started to do the 100 making its 100% wholly own subsidiary by the way of share swapping. So that process is already going on. So, I think by end of the Q2 we'll complete it.

capital_allocation.claim: The 130 crore new capex will be funded by taking debt of around 70 crore and the remaining from internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: We are taking the debt of around 70 CR and remaining from the internal...

capital_allocation.claim: The company plans to fund the new capex through a mix of term loans and internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: we are planning to get some in terms of term loan from the bank for the at least INR 65 to 70 CR of the term loan and remaining from internal funds.

risks_headwinds.claim: Remember India Health links is currently in an investment and turnaround phase, weighing on consolidated margins in the near term.
risks_headwinds.quote: Remember India Health links is currently in an investment and turnaround phase as we build and strengthen the business. This has also weighted our own consolidated margin in the near terms.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that raw material prices and global supply chain conditions are currently disturbed.
risks_headwinds.quote: but see, the prices of raw material and global supply chain is totally disturbed, so I think it is not possible for me to predict what is going to happen after this quarter and what will be the situation.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to complete the share swapping process to make Apiqo and Bizoc 100% subsidiaries by the end of Q2.
management_commitments.quote: So that process is already going on. So, I think by end of the Q2 we'll complete it.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to file seven new DMFs within FY27.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are on the track to file the new seven DMFs within this FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to achieve positive cash flow by the end of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Mostly FY end of FY27, it will be positive.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to launch seven new APIs in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, our priorities remain focused on launching of seven new APIs in FY27 across additional therapeutic categories

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to file three to five additional DMFs in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: filing three to five additional DMF in FY27 to deepen regulated market penetration and long- term revenue visibility

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
